ai-dynamo/agent-plugins.name: agent-plugins
ai-dynamo/agent-plugins.readme_excerpt: Small agent integrations that send session identity to Dynamo. - `pi-plugin/` - Pi provider for Dynamo's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. - `hermes-plugin/` - Hermes middleware that maps Hermes `session_id` to `x-dynamo-session-id`. - `openclaw-plugin/` - OpenClaw provider that maps OpenClaw `sessionId` to `x-dynamo-session-id`. Each plugin owns its install, configuration, and validation instructions. Harbor-specific integration files live with the plugin they adapt. The Pi adapter is in `pi-plugin/harbor/`.

ai-dynamo/evenmoe.name: evenmoe
ai-dynamo/evenmoe.readme_excerpt: A framework-independent library for expert placement and token routing in Mixture-of-Experts inference aiming to solve the MoE load imbalance issue and improve the MoE model serving efficiency. EvenMoE brings placement and routing policies behind a unified Python API, with adapters for different inference backend. EvenMoE balances work at two levels: - **L1 — Expert placement:** chooses which logical experts occupy physical expert slots across GPUs, including redundant replicas. - **L2 — Token routing:** selects a physical replica for each logical routing expert selected by TopK and, when enabled, a destination GPU for shared-expert computation. The architecture separates framework-independent policy logic

ai-dynamo/flextensor.name: flextensor
ai-dynamo/flextensor.description: FlexTensor is a tensor offloading and management library for PyTorch that enables running large models on limited GPU memory by intelligently offloading tensors between GPU and CPU memory.
ai-dynamo/flextensor.readme_excerpt: --> **Run larger models within your GPU memory budget.** FlexTensor is a weight-offloading library for large-model inference, supporting PyTorch models and integration with vLLM. It keeps selected model weights in CPU RAM and streams them to the GPU as needed, helping you run models whose weights would otherwise exceed available GPU memory without reducing model size or precision. FlexTensor profiles execution and prefetches upcoming weights to overlap transfers with GPU computation. This can hide transfer overhead in compute-heavy workloads. The achievable memory savings and inference speed depend on your model, workload and CPU–GPU bandwidth. FlexTensor is actively developed at NVIDIA,
